name: McGill Curl-Up
steps: Lie on your back with one leg straight on the floor, the opposite knee bent with foot flat, and both hands tucked under your lower back.
Brace your abdominal wall firmly while preserving the natural arch of your lower back over your hands.
Lift your head, neck, and upper shoulders slightly off the floor as one rigid unit without tucking your chin.
Hold steadily while breathing smoothly, lower back gently, and switch your bent leg halfway through the set.
tips: Keep your cervical spine neutral as if looking straight at the ceiling rather than pulling your chin to your chest.
Avoid flattening your lower back aggressively into your hands; maintain a neutral lumbar arch.
